name: repertoire
description: Repertoire: skills for Claude Code and Cowork, plus an opt-in SearXNG search server for the research skill.

plugins.name: repertoire
plugins.description: Skills for Claude Code and Cowork: create and review skills, research a topic with parallel subagents, write changelogs, READMEs and CLAUDE.md files, draw Mermaid diagrams, design frontends, and find more skills.

plugins.name: repertoire-searxng
plugins.description: Adds the SearXNG MCP server (mcp-searxng) so the research skill can search the web through your own SearXNG instance. Needs a running SearXNG with the JSON format enabled. Runs in Claude Code and desktop Cowork, not in cloud Cowork sessions.

searxng_url.title: SearXNG URL
searxng_url.description: Address of your SearXNG instance, with the JSON format enabled. Keep the default if SearXNG runs on this computer on port 8888.
